field.label: Enable AI content inspection
field.help: Decrypts traffic to the AI services selected for inspection through a transparent proxy and checks what is sent for sensitive data. Only those services are decrypted; all other traffic is untouched. Requires the privacy notice to be acknowledged (AI Audit > Privacy) and the inspection CA to be installed on the clients.

field.label: Inspect every AI service
field.help: Also inspect the services that have no rule of their own (the default action applies). Otherwise only services with "Inspect content" ticked in their rule are inspected.

field.label: Payment card numbers
field.help: Numbers of 13-19 digits that pass the Luhn check.

field.label: Identity numbers
field.help: US SSN, Indian Aadhaar (checksum verified) and PAN, IBAN (checksum verified), UK National Insurance number.

field.label: API keys and secrets
field.help: Provider keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS, Google, GitHub, Slack, Stripe), private keys, JWTs, bearer tokens and password / token assignments with high entropy.

field.label: Source code
field.help: Heuristic: several lines that look like code. Only the line count and language are recorded, never the code.

field.label: Source code threshold (lines)
field.help: Minimum number of code-like lines before a request counts as source code.

field.label: Largest body scanned (KB)
field.help: Only the first part of larger bodies is scanned. Binary uploads (images, archives, PDFs) are never scanned.

field.label: Message shown when blocked
field.help: {what} is replaced by the kind of data found, for example "a payment card number". Plain text only.
